established.statement: The chosen right-dual operation supplies an explicit right double-dual endofunctor.
A pivotal structure is required to be a monoidal natural isomorphism from the identity functor to the right double-dual functor, not merely an objectwise isomorphism.
The EGNO left categorical trace, pivotal trace, and pivotal dimension are explicit Lean morphisms.
The spherical contract requires pivotal dimensions to agree under duality.
The balancing contract enforces EGNO equation (8.32).
The ribbon contract enforces compatibility of the twist with duality.
The Kirby path now consumes an EGNO ribbon structure and an EGNO spherical structure instead of arbitrary twist and closure functions.
